genius.headline: Duke-led team uses a 13-ion quantum simulator to watch particle 'strings' break and new pairs form
genius.summary: A team led by the Duke Quantum Center used a trapped-ion quantum simulator to watch "string breaking", the process in which pulling two linked particles apart creates new particle pairs. The work was published in Nature Physics on September 23, 2026. The researchers encoded the model into a chain of 13 ions controlled by focused laser beams, and the university calls it one of the earliest demonstrations of its kind.

quote.text: Researchers led by the Duke Quantum Center (DQC) have used a quantum simulator to observe string breaking dynamics connected to particle antiparticle formation, marking one of the earliest demonstrations of its kind in quantum physics.

facepalm.headline: Some Montgomery County, Md., voter guides list wrong polling place or party in 11 precincts
facepalm.summary: Montgomery County, Maryland's Board of Elections said on September 23 that several Voter Information Guides mailed in one batch to voters in 11 precincts in the Clarksburg, Germantown and Poolesville areas listed an incorrect polling place and/or party affiliation. The board said its printing vendor would mail replacement guides and had assured it that guides for the other 246 precincts were correct.

quote.text: Voters in Montgomery County were mailed sample ballots that were printed with errors on them, officials said.
